description: This file is a mock header file for testing, defining mock functions related to DNS forwarding within a network management project. It includes licensing info, include directives, and declarations for functions used to set and delete DNS forwarding behaviors.

methods.name: _setForwarding
methods.description: Sets up DNS forwarding for a given object, function, arguments, and returns status.

methods.name: _deleteForwarding
methods.description: Removes DNS forwarding for a given object, function, arguments, and returns status.
